block.prompt:
Read Emma's letter again. Choose the best answer for each question.

1. Why did Emma write to the magazine?  (A — She had to write it for school. / B — She has wanted a pen pal from another country for a long time. / C — Her teacher told her to write. / D — She wants to practise her English.)
2. How does Emma feel about her brother?  (A — She finds him very annoying and dislikes him. / B — She loves him very much and they never argue. / C — She finds him annoying but still cares about him. / D — She does not mention her feelings about him.)
3. What does Emma wish she could do at school?  (A — Be better at Maths. / B — Skip school entirely. / C — Spend all her time drawing or doing art. / D — Travel with her class.)
watch_outs: Frage 2: Schüler:innen wählen oft A, weil das Wort 'annoying' dominant ist — darauf hinweisen, den ganzen Satz zu lesen ('I guess I love him')
Frage 3: Schüler:innen dürfen A wählen (Maths verbessern), aber der Text zeigt, dass Emma das als Lehrerwunsch liest, nicht als ihren eigenen Wunsch
